## What this folder is

Living **architecture and craft** reference — not prose. Updated after each edit session. When `Draft_06/` and this bible disagree, **`Draft_06/` + `PARKING_LOT.md` win** (unless a lock in `07` says otherwise).

Story Bible is **draft-version neutral** — it stays here while `Draft_06/`, `Draft_07/`, etc. hold manuscript snapshots.

## Files (print order)

1. `01_Synopsis_and_Acts.md` — story spine + three acts + Greek tragedy engine  
2. `02_Chapter_Outline.md` — all 41 chapters: title + chapter job  
3. `06_Chapter_Expanded.md` — one paragraph per chapter  
4. `03_Character_Depth_Hierarchy.md` — depth tiers, voice, never rules  
5. `04_Prose_DNA.md` — POV, voice, motif budgets, ending DNA  
6. `05_Sudbury_Geography_Brief.md` — town map canon  
7. `07_Pass_2_Focus.md` — edit-pass checklist, chapter map, session order  
8. `08_Phrase_Ledger.md` — locked phrases, refrain budgets  
9. `09_Workflow.md` — structure → review → line edit loop (plain language)

**Print export:** `Walk_This_Way_Story_Bible_PRINT.txt` — regenerate after bible edits.

**Shelf reference:** `Novel_Docs/Walk_This_Way_Blueprint_v2.0_PRINT.txt` (Draft 2; superseded)

**Legacy in this folder:** `character-bible.md`, `timeline.md`, etc. — pre–Draft_05 notes; use numbered files above for canon.
